summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts, inflating them 100x.
recommended: Fix the currency handling bug in v1.4 and add a test that compares ledger amounts with order amounts before redeploying.
The sync_interval_s 5->4 change was unrelated; no action is needed.

events.text: v1.4 is corrupting the ledger (amounts ×100). The sync_interval change is unrelated. I'll roll back first.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
